objective: Refactor CheckoutPage.tsx state management by moving 15+ React states, Supabase fetch methods, and form validation functions into a dedicated custom hook `useCheckoutOrchestrator.ts` to follow MVVM patterns.
assumptions: Deno and Next.js are available to test compilation.

pre_checks.claim: CheckoutPage.tsx contains 15+ React states and direct Supabase load calls.

steps.title: Create useCheckoutOrchestrator hook
steps.changes: Implement state orchestration, address/invoice loaders, validation functions, and step transition handlers.

steps.title: Update useCheckoutPayment signature
steps.changes: Simplify Props structure to use grouped state structures instead of raw flat parameters.

steps.title: Refactor CheckoutPage component
steps.changes: Integrate useCheckoutOrchestrator VM hook, delete direct state/effects, and bind UI props directly.
steps.verify: pnpm run type-check && pnpm exec vitest run

risks.risk: Incorrect callback wiring could disrupt the state updates or payment form render.
risks.mitigation: Ensure exact mapping of state setter bindings and verify vitest unit test runs.

rollback: Use git checkout -- . to discard all changes.

architectural_guardrails.ssot_route_strategy: The changes only optimize state orchestration inside the page views without affecting routing tables.
architectural_guardrails.bundle_size_optimization: No foreign libraries are imported. Bundle size remains completely unaffected.
